purpose: Provider-neutral source plan for an uncapped disease Surface Atlas census.

rosalind_workbench.role: launcher and settings surface; companion skills supply scientific operations

direct_viewers.role: inspect retained structures, chains, residues, contacts, and saved viewer state
inspect isoforms, alignments, construct boundaries, and designed sequences

capability_plan.interpretation: discovery-required marks a suggested capability to check in the current task. Record installed skills, callable tools, and selected routes when preparing the project.

sources.name: PubMed via NCBI Entrez
sources.role: primary disease, target, surface, mechanism, and treatment literature
sources.retrieval_scope: citation metadata, abstracts, identifiers, and query-specific result pages

sources.name: PubMed Central
sources.role: open full text, figures, supplements, methods, and cited identifiers
sources.retrieval_scope: open-access full text and article-level artifacts

sources.name: bioRxiv
sources.role: biology preprints that may precede indexed literature
sources.retrieval_scope: preprint metadata and text where supplied by the source
sources.pagination: date window with cursor or page state

sources.name: medRxiv
sources.role: clinical and translational preprints
sources.retrieval_scope: preprint metadata and text where supplied by the source
sources.pagination: date window with cursor or page state

sources.name: Open Targets Platform
sources.role: disease-target associations and evidence links
sources.retrieval_scope: target-disease evidence and linked data types

sources.name: cBioPortal
sources.role: study, cohort, mutation, copy-number, expression, and clinical-context discovery
sources.retrieval_scope: public cancer-study metadata and scoped molecular records

sources.name: CIViC
sources.role: curated cancer variant, evidence, and therapy associations
sources.retrieval_scope: variant evidence and disease-specific assertions

sources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
sources.role: trial discovery, intervention names, status, eligibility, and disease context
sources.retrieval_scope: study records and intervention fields

sources.name: CELLxGENE
sources.role: discover relevant datasets and cell annotations
sources.retrieval_scope: dataset and collection metadata only through the visible skill
sources.limitation: Metadata discovery is not gene-by-cell matrix analysis. Matrix retrieval and analysis are separate recorded work.

sources.name: BioStudies and ArrayExpress
sources.role: discover public functional-genomics and expression studies
sources.retrieval_scope: study metadata and accession-level record discovery

sources.name: ENCODE
sources.role: functional-genomics experiments and regulatory context
sources.retrieval_scope: experiment metadata and public record discovery

sources.name: PRIDE
sources.role: proteomics dataset discovery and accession tracking
sources.retrieval_scope: dataset metadata, accessions, and linked files

sources.name: ProteomeXchange
sources.role: proteomics dataset discovery across member repositories
sources.retrieval_scope: dataset metadata, accessions, and linked files

sources.name: Human Protein Atlas
sources.role: normal tissue, cell type, pathology, and subcellular-context lookup after target identity is known
sources.retrieval_scope: target-level normal and pathology context

sources.name: Bgee
sources.role: cross-species expression and anatomy context after target identity is known
sources.retrieval_scope: gene expression and anatomy annotations

sources.name: UniProt
sources.role: canonical identity, isoforms, topology, domains, extracellular regions, and functional annotations
sources.retrieval_scope: protein records and feature annotations

sources.name: Ensembl
sources.role: gene, transcript, protein, variant, and coordinate identity resolution
sources.retrieval_scope: stable identifiers, transcripts, coordinates, and variants

sources.name: ClinVar
sources.role: clinical-variant assertions after target or locus identity is known
sources.retrieval_scope: variant assertions and review status

sources.name: gnomAD
sources.role: population-variation context after target identity is known
sources.retrieval_scope: population allele-frequency and constraint context

sources.name: GWAS Catalog
sources.role: trait and association discovery after disease or locus identity is known
sources.retrieval_scope: association metadata and linked variants

sources.name: GTEx eQTL
sources.role: normal-tissue expression and eQTL context after target identity is known
sources.retrieval_scope: tissue-level eQTL records

sources.name: eQTL Catalogue
sources.role: study-specific eQTL context after target identity is known
sources.retrieval_scope: study and cell-context eQTL records

sources.name: Reactome
sources.role: pathway context after target identity is known
sources.retrieval_scope: pathway membership and pathway records

sources.name: STRING
sources.role: interaction-network context after target identity is known
sources.retrieval_scope: network edges and evidence channels

sources.name: QuickGO
sources.role: gene-ontology annotations, including cellular component evidence
sources.retrieval_scope: annotation records and evidence codes

sources.name: ChEMBL
sources.role: target-linked bioactivity, drug, assay, and mechanism records
sources.retrieval_scope: molecule, assay, target, and activity records

sources.name: BindingDB
sources.role: target-linked binding measurements and ligand records
sources.retrieval_scope: protein-ligand binding records and assay context

sources.name: PubChem
sources.role: compound identity, bioassay links, and structure retrieval
sources.retrieval_scope: compound, substance, and assay records

sources.name: ChEBI
sources.role: small-molecule and chemical-entity identity normalization
sources.retrieval_scope: chemical-entity records and ontology relations

sources.name: PharmGKB
sources.role: pharmacogenomic context after target or intervention identity is known
sources.retrieval_scope: drug, gene, variant, and pathway annotations

sources.name: RCSB Protein Data Bank
sources.role: experimental structures, assemblies, ligands, complexes, constructs, and coordinates
sources.retrieval_scope: structure metadata, coordinates, experimental method, and entity records

sources.name: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database
sources.role: predicted monomer models and confidence annotations
sources.retrieval_scope: predicted monomer coordinates and confidence data
sources.limitation: Predicted monomers establish model availability; ligand, antibody, receptor, and binder complexes require complex-specific records.

additional_sources.name: NCI Genomic Data Commons
additional_sources.needed_for: cancer cohort and harmonized molecular-data expansion
additional_sources.recorded_action: Register a public-API or imported-data lane with its own query receipt and data-version record.

additional_sources.name: COSMIC
additional_sources.recorded_action: Register licensed-access or manual-import provenance before use.

additional_sources.name: DepMap
additional_sources.recorded_action: Register a public-download or imported-data lane and retain release identifiers.

additional_sources.name: OncoKB
additional_sources.recorded_action: Register access terms and version before importing evidence.

additional_sources.name: International Cancer Genome Consortium
additional_sources.recorded_action: Register a public-API or imported-data lane with release provenance.

additional_sources.name: Orphanet, OMIM, MONDO, HPO, and GARD
additional_sources.needed_for: rare-disease naming, phenotype, and epidemiology expansion
additional_sources.recorded_action: Register each source and its identifier mapping as an explicit imported or public-API lane.

additional_sources.name: Dedicated surfaceome database
additional_sources.recorded_action: Use literature, topology, proteomics, and normal-context lanes; record any added source separately.

additional_sources.name: FDA and EMA label sources
additional_sources.recorded_action: Register official label URLs, retrieval dates, and document hashes in the intervention lane.

additional_sources.name: Therapeutic antibody, ADC, CAR, TCR, radiopharmaceutical, and payload registries
additional_sources.recorded_action: Use source-specific literature, trial, sponsor, and regulatory records with stable identifiers.

additional_sources.name: Gene-by-cell and spatial expression matrix analysis
additional_sources.needed_for: cell-level target quantification and spatial co-localization
additional_sources.recorded_action: Create a separate data-download and matrix-analysis workflow; preserve matrix version, preprocessing, and execution receipt.
